Dans Explorateur, Haut/Bas choisissent u:
In Explorer, Up/Down selects an item and Enter opens the file or folder. Backspace goes to the parent folder. With touch, tap to select, then tap the selected item again to open it, with no time limit. Copy / Cut prepares the item; Paste acts in the current folder.

System files remain accessible for updating data. Amber colouring indicates their role; hidden items are dimmed. Changing or deleting a configuration, language, font or catalogue can affect Tab5OS: keep a copy before making your own changes.

Save writes the current document. Save as chooses another name or folder. Autosave follows the interval in Settings. Explorer updates after a change; F5 also refreshes it. The eye button hides or shows the selected item without renaming it. Ctrl+H shows hidden items. This choice is specific to Tab5OS and stored on the drive; it does not change the attributes used by Windows. Folder previews count all visible items, then let you browse their list page by page. The hidden .Tab5Backups subfolder keeps previous backups. Incomplete saves are reported; leave the SD card in place while writing.

File names and document text are personal data: changing the interface language does not translate them.

The magnifying glass or Ctrl+F searches file and folder names in the current folder and all its subfolders. Case and Latin accents are ignored; all search words must be present. Results appear progressively with their folder. Partial searches are indicated: refine the words if necessary. The cross appears only during a search and removes the filter. Text and source files, including .py scripts, open in Writing without running automatically.

A .bin file opens the Firmware page. Verify checks the ESP32-P4 target, revision, size and fingerprint. Install writes to the inactive partition and validates the image before changing the next boot target. Restart activates it. Use an application binary made for this Tab5, without a bootloader or partition table. Keep the power supply stable.
Sur Carte, sélectionnez la carte puis En:
On Map, select the map and press Enter to control it. Arrow keys move the view; + / − changes zoom; Home goes to the home position. Escape returns the arrows to navigation between controls. Ctrl+F opens search.

Saved places let you visit, rename or delete a position. Style selects the map background. Offline .t5map packages and the SD cache let you view tiles already available. Online searches and missing tiles require a connection. Searched place names follow the selected language when the service provides it.

Portrait reading opens text or EPUB. Previous / next page, Left / Right and Up / Down turn EPUB pages when controls are not selected. Up / Down scrolls text. Backspace or Escape exits reading or the full-screen image. The percentage and page number refer to the entire book. A ~ sign indicates a provisional percentage during the first calculation; the total becomes exact when layout finishes. Titles and names supplied by your files keep their original language.
L’accueil sépare les outils intégrés, le:
Home separates built-in tools, ELF applications and Python applications. Applications are sorted by type and name. Built-in tools remain available without an SD card. F5 refreshes the catalogue; this is not an online store.

Settings → Home lets you choose visible applications, their order within each section, icons, grid or list layout, size and labels. Save keeps these choices on the Tab5. Back discards changes. Reset restores the default layout after Save; files and applications are not deleted. Settings remains available in the sidebar.

Exiting a Python application closes its screen and returns to the previous OS screen. For applications offering Hide, that command keeps execution running. The sidebar resume button or Ctrl+Alt+P restores a hidden application while it remains active. Stop or Ctrl+. requests it to stop. When another application needs to stop before launching, confirm the proposed switch.

Maps → Download opens the area form with the current centre, zoom and map background. Choose a city or coordinates, radius and zooms, then check the estimate. OpenTopoMap downloads directly on the tablet; pause/resume keeps progress. OpenStreetMap requires a source that allows these downloads or preparation on a PC. Return to Maps to view the result without restarting.

Wikipedia presents local and online results in the same pagination, without isolating a local result on its own page. An existing local copy takes priority. After reading online, Save this page makes it available offline. Options groups automatic saving, updates and complete downloads with language selection. A new complete archive requires confirmation before downloading. The reader keeps portrait orientation, text size and line spacing.

IRC Chat remembers nickname and server. Channels lets you join, leave, add or remove favourites and find recent channels. Hide keeps the connection. No message history is stored on the SD card; preferences remain in /System/irc.json.

Import radios uses Radio Browser. Wi-Fi and a correct date are required for secure connections.

In the Wikipedia reader, text links open other articles, searching local copies first. Backspace or Escape returns to results; Alt+Left also goes back. Illustrations in the reading toolbar shows or hides images. A local result's menu lets you delete the displayed copy or archive after confirmation. Tables keep their cells and horizontal scrolling.
Réglages → Système → Partage ouvre un pa:
Settings → System → Sharing opens a temporary read/write share. Current network uses your existing Wi-Fi: the PC must be on the same network. Direct network creates a temporary Wi-Fi network; first disable the OS Wi-Fi, then connect the PC using the displayed name and password.

Open the displayed address in the PC browser and enter the code. No extra software is needed. The browser lets you browse, download, upload, rename and delete files, and create folders. Sharing stops after 30 minutes or with Stop.

During a transfer, leave the card in place and avoid editing the same file in an application. Stop sharing before changing Wi-Fi. This is browser access; the card does not appear as a USB drive letter in Windows.
L’éditeur Écriture ouvre aussi les fichi:
The Writing editor also opens Python files and other source files. Code stays unchanged, with visual highlighting. The Code menu groups Run, Stop, Resume, Libraries and Console. Run saves the .py file first; if saving fails, it does not start. The console can occupy the right pane.

Ctrl+Enter: save and run Python. Ctrl+.: stop. Ctrl+Shift+R: resume. Ctrl+Shift+L: show or hide the console. The editor's usual shortcuts remain available.

Documents keeps a list of files, even after they are unloaded from memory. The cross removes a listing, never the SD file. Ctrl+Shift+O opens this list; Ctrl+Tab / Ctrl+Shift+Tab switches to the next / previous document. Changing documents saves modifications; an error keeps the current document open.

Create a project with this document then groups other files. Add document to project adds to the selected group. Import a folder scans it progressively and detects new files while the editor is visible. Outside project keeps independent files. A file removed with the cross is not added again automatically.

Libraries opens the MicroPython catalogue, with target-board selection and modules added to the corresponding project. Libraries intended for another board stay separate from the Tab5 libraries; their drivers are not run on the Tab5. Declared compatibility does not guarantee operation on a specific board. CPython packages and native extensions are incompatible. Automatic uploading or flashing of another board is not provided.

Bundled scripts remain in /MicroPython. Check SD card compares resources before repair, preserves personal files and backs up each replaced file.

A compatible .elf file launches an application without replacing the OS. Its launch settings can be saved: ask for a file, run without a file, or always use the same file. Paths use sd:/Folder/file.ext for microSD and usb:/Folder/file.ext for the USB drive. They are not terminal commands. Stopping is cooperative. These applications can access OS memory: use trusted binaries built with the supplied SDK. A .bin file remains a firmware update.
Créer un thème : choisissez une couleur:
Create a theme: choose a colour from the list or by touching an object in the preview. Adjust R, G and B or enter #RRGGBB, then save. The Black / White slider darkens or lightens the colour symmetrically; at the centre it preserves the starting colour.

In Explorer, select a file, then Open with… and choose a compatible ELF application. The launcher also offers a file and folder picker, recent items and favourites. Run starts the program; Ctrl+. requests it to stop.

Game Boy: arrow keys and physical Z/X keys control the directional pad and A/B. Enter = Start, Backspace = Select. Escape exits and saves the state. The floppy-disk button saves without exiting; the circular arrow restarts the game. .gb files open Game Boy; .gbc files open Game Boy Color. Saves and states are in /Saves/GB or /Saves/GBC. The last compatible state resumes when the ROM is next opened.
Réglages → Stockage ouvre les commandes:
Settings → Storage opens the microSD and USB controls, even without an SD card. Reconnect microSD restarts detection; Open in the microSD panel goes to the root /. A compatible USB drive or card reader can mount automatically; this option can be disabled. USB files appear under /USB. Copy, paste, create, rename and delete work on both drives.

Save documents and stop applications or transfers using the drive before choosing Eject in the drive’s panel. An operation in progress may prevent ejection. Wait for confirmation before removing the card or unplugging the drive. One USB drive can be mounted at a time, alongside a keyboard and mouse on the hub. FAT16/FAT32 are supported.

Restore missing files progressively recreates missing standard system files from the firmware. Cancel interrupts this work. Existing files, documents and customisations are preserved. This function does not replace damaged files already present and does not recover deleted files. Fonts, encyclopaedias and .app.elf applications must still be supplied separately.

Without a usable SD font, the interface temporarily uses English and the built-in font, without changing the saved language or your document text. Restarting with the font restores the selected language. This version offers neither formatting nor recovery of erased data.
